title: Brazil Central Bank (BCB) Macro & Rates Input

mode.title: Dataset Mode
mode.description: Choose SGS macroeconomic series (Selic, CDI, IPCA), Focus Market Expectations, Bank Credit Interest Rates, or PTAX FX rates.

sgsCode.title: SGS Series Code
sgsCode.description: Official BCB SGS code for sgs_series mode (432=Selic Meta, 12=CDI, 433=IPCA, 189=IGP-M, 24369=Unemployment, 21082=Delinquency).

lastN.title: Last N Data Points
lastN.description: Number of most recent observations to fetch in sgs_series mode.

indicator.title: Focus Indicator Filter
indicator.description: Optional indicator filter in focus_expectations mode (e.g. IPCA, Selic, PIB Total, Câmbio, IGP-M).

currency.title: PTAX Currency Code
currency.description: Currency symbol for ptax_fx mode (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CHF).

startDate.title: Start Date (MM-DD-YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)
startDate.description: Optional start date for ptax_fx mode (defaults to 15 days ago).

endDate.title: End Date (MM-DD-YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)
endDate.description: Optional end date for ptax_fx mode (defaults to today).

query.title: Institution, Modality, or Keyword Filter
query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter across bank name, credit modality, or indicator.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of normalized rows returned.

timeoutSecs.title: Request Timeout (Seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: HTTP timeout in seconds when calling BCB endpoints.
